Additional savings in gasoline, energy, cast iron, and steel would result and additional small improvements in water quality, small decreases in industrial water supply demand and small reductions in stationary source air pollution are likely to result. Additional aluminum and plastics would be used and additional energy would be consumed in their production, transportation and use in manufacturing vehicles. Also, a small degradation in water quality, an increase in industrial water supply demand and a small increase in stationary source air pollution could result because of the additional use of aluminum and plastics.
